back_translation: I am the man who has seen affliction under the rod of His wrath.
He has driven me away and made me walk in darkness, not in light.
Indeed, He has turned against me again and again, all day long.
He has made my flesh and skin waste away; He has broken all my bones.
He has besieged me and surrounded me with bitterness and hardship.
He has made me dwell in thick darkness, like those long dead.
He has walled me in so I cannot get out; He has weighed me down with bronze chains.
Even when I cry out and plead for help, He shuts out my prayer.
He has blocked my way with hewn stone; He has made my paths crooked.
He is to me like a bear lying in ambush, like a lion lurking to pounce.
He dragged me from my path and tore me to pieces; He left me desolate.
He bent His bow and set me up as the target for His arrows.
He shot arrows from His quiver into my kidneys.
I have become a laughingstock to all my people, their mocking song all day long.
He has filled me to the full with bitterness; He has made me drunk with poisonous wormwood.
He has ground my teeth with gravel; He has trampled me down into the ashes.
My soul has been torn from peace; I have forgotten what prosperity is.
So I said, 'My splendor has perished, and all the hope I had from the LORD.'
Remember my affliction and my wandering, the poisonous wormwood and the bitter gall.
My soul still remembers without ceasing and is bowed down within me.
But this I call back to mind, and therefore I have hope:
Because of the steadfast love of the LORD we are not consumed, for His mercies never come to an end.
They are new every morning; great is Your faithfulness.
My soul says, 'The LORD is my portion; therefore I will hope in Him.'
The LORD is good to those who wait for Him, to the soul that seeks Him.
It is good to wait quietly for the salvation of the LORD.
It is good for a young man to bear the yoke from his youth.
Let him sit alone in silence, for He has laid it upon him.
Let him bury his face in the dust — perhaps there may yet be hope.
Let him offer his cheek to the one who strikes him; let him take his fill of disgrace.
For the Lord will not cast off forever.
Though He causes grief, He will yet show mercy according to His abundant steadfast love.
For He does not willingly afflict or grieve the children of men.
To crush underfoot all the prisoners of the land,
to pervert a man's justice before the Most High,
to cheat a man in his lawsuit — of these the Lord does not approve.
Who can speak and have it come to pass, unless the Lord has commanded it?
Do not both calamity and good come from the mouth of the Most High?
Why should a living man complain — any man — about the punishment of his sins?
Let us examine and test our ways, and return to the LORD.
Let us lift up our hearts along with our hands to God in heaven.
'We have transgressed and rebelled, and You have not forgiven.
You have wrapped Yourself in anger and pursued us; You have slain without mercy.
You have covered Yourself with a cloud so that no prayer can pass through.
You have made us scum and refuse among the peoples.'
All our enemies open their mouths against us.
Terror and pitfall have come upon us, devastation and destruction.
Streams of tears flow down from my eyes because of the destruction of the daughter of my people.
My eyes pour down unceasingly, without relief,
until the LORD looks down from heaven and sees.
What my eyes see brings pain to my soul, because of all the daughters of my city.
My enemies hunted me like a bird, without cause.
They threw me alive into the pit and hurled stones at me.
Water flowed over my head; I said, 'I am cut off.'
O LORD, I called on Your name from the lowest depths of the pit.
You heard my voice: 'Do not close Your ear to my cry for relief.'
You came near on the day I called to You, and You said, 'Do not be afraid.'
O Lord, You have pleaded the cause of my soul; You have redeemed my life.
O LORD, You have seen the injustice done to me; judge my case.
You have seen all their vengeance, all the schemes they devise against me.
O LORD, You have heard their taunts, all their plots against me.
The lips of those who rise against me, and their whispering against me all day long.
Look! Whether they sit or rise, I am their mocking song.
O LORD, You will repay them according to the work of their hands.
You will give them hardness and blindness of heart; may Your curse fall upon them.
You will pursue them in wrath and destroy them from under the heavens of the LORD.
